learning_outcomes.text: Recall basic mathematical structures and operations.
Understand and use the meanings of these conceptual structures and operations.
Learn mathematics meaningfully by relating it to real life.
Understand the concepts of mathematical model and modeling.

syllabus_topics: Definition and importance of mathematical modeling.
Empirical and mechanical mathematical models / Mechanical model concepts
Mathematical modeling in the context of logic, conditional probability, percentage calculations and sets, linear function, data analysis, ratio-proportion and probability.
Mathematical modeling in the context of random number concept, simulation and Pythagorean Theorem.
Mathematical modeling in the context of triangle geometry and trigonometric ratios.
Mathematical modeling in the context of unit circle, trigonometric functions, inverse trigonometric functions and derivatives.
Mathematical modeling in the context of analytical geometry, derivatives, functions, functions of two variables and graphs.
Supervised and unsupervised learning / Clustering, classification, regression concepts
Artificial Neural Networks, Support Vector Machines
Decision Trees and Random Forest Applications
